rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one subjected to cutting
negation particle denying the effect of cutting
optative verb expressing the negated result of being cut
compound indicating absorption or attainment of that state
compound indicating the mind being directed toward that state

items.question: Does complete absorption in that state prevent harm from being physically cut?
premises: A person may be subjected to physical cutting.
A person can be absorbed in that state.
A person can have the mind fixed on that state.
items.inference: One absorbed in that state with mind fixed there remains unaffected by cutting.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' (tad) is supplied by the preceding context.
The exact force of yathā here may be comparative or illustrative.
items.plain_english: Even while being cut, one who has gone to that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not cut.
